profile.ja: 陰陽師養成機関・五行学園に所属する学生術師。高性能な電子頭脳を利用した風水術を得意とするデジタル道士。正確に計測した地脈や星の巡りから吉凶を占い、ラッキーアイテムやラッキーカラーを導き出す。また八卦コンピュータとドローンを操作して、五行相克に則った的確な攻撃や防御行動をとることも出来る。おせっかいかつ世話焼きで、恋バナも大好き。占いで導き出した開運アイテムを人に押し付けがちで、煙たがられることも。好きな食べものは、餡餅やお惣菜パン、ピロシキなど。趣味はおしゃべりと占いと掃除で、散らかった部屋を見ると風水的に許せないらしく、掃除したいという欲求が収まらなくなる。
profile.en: She is a student technician affiliated with the Gosha Academy, a training institution for onmyodo practitioners. As a digital Taoist, she specializes in feng shui techniques that utilize high-performance electronic brains, accurately measuring the flow of energy in the land and the movements of the stars to predict good or bad fortune and guide people to lucky items and colors. She can also operate the bagua computer and drones to take precise attack or defense actions based on the five elements. She is a bit of a meddler and loves to take care of others, and is also fond of love banter. She tends to force people to accept lucky items she has divined, which can be annoying. Her favorite foods are anko, oden, and pirozhki, and her hobbies are chatting, divination, and cleaning. She has a strong desire to clean when she sees a cluttered room, as it is unbearable from a feng shui perspective.

text.ja: 五行学園からきました、丹陽華だよ～♪　任務も運気も、ばっちりサポートさせてもらうからね～、よろしく～
text.en: I'm Tan Youka from the Gosha Academy - I'll be supporting you with missions and luck, so look forward to it, okay?

text.ja: 噂の隊長さんとお会いできるの、楽しみにしてたんだよね～。巻き込まれ体質で、すごく運気の流れが悪いと聞いていたんだ～♪
text.en: I was looking forward to meeting the famous Captain - I've heard that you have a tendency to get caught up in things and that your luck is really bad.

text.ja: こんにちは～、隊長さ～ん♪　さっそくだけど、おうちに伺ってもいい？　あ、大丈夫だよ？　お部屋の模様替えするだけだから
text.en: Hello, Captain - may I come in? Don't worry, I just want to redecorate the room a bit.

text.ja: たった数日、一緒にいただけだけど……聞きしに勝る、ってやつだよね～。んも～、改善させてあげるのが、楽しみだなぁ～
text.en: Even though we've only been together for a few days, I can tell that there's more to you than meets the eye - I'm looking forward to helping you improve.

text.ja: とりあえずのところ、気になってる運勢はなぁい？　金運、仕事運、女運――なんでもござれ、風水で円満解決してあげるよ～
text.en: By the way, are you concerned about your current luck? Whether it's financial luck, career luck, or love luck, I can help you find a solution using feng shui.

text.ja: 風水はねぇ、オカルトじゃないんだよ？　統計学だとか、そういった要素もあるからこそ、高い効果が期待できるんだから
text.en: Feng shui isn't just about the occult, you know? It's also based on statistical elements, which is why it can be so effective.

text.ja: いまのあなたの寝床――ズバリ、北西枕でしょ？　あはっ、やっぱり～♪　北西枕はねぇ、勝負運とか出世運がよくなるんだよ～
text.en: I bet your bed is positioned with your pillow to the northwest, isn't it? Ah, I knew it - a northwest pillow can really improve your luck with competitions and career advancement.

text.ja: まずは掃除だよね。周りがすっきりしてると、運気の流れもよくなるし……あとはインテリアかな。一緒に探しにいこっか？
text.en: First, we need to clean the room - when the surroundings are tidy, the flow of luck improves, and then we can work on the interior design together.

text.ja: 運気をよくする、もうひとつの方法も試してみる？　陰陽の思想を基にした、房中術っていうんだけど～――あっ、なんで逃げるの！
text.en: Want to try another way to improve your luck? It's called feng shui sex techniques, based on the principles of yin and yang - ah, why are you running away?

text.ja: ほらぁ……んっ、あはぁっ……こうやってぇ、男女でまじわるとぉ……お互いの気が、互いを循環して……好運を呼び込むんだよぉ
text.en: See... like this, when a man and woman are intimate, their energies circulate and attract good luck.

text.ja: もっとぉ……んっ、はぁっ、激しくぅ……男の陽を、女の陰に、だし入れしてぇ……あんっ、あっっ♪　いっぱい、いっぱいだしてぇっ♪
text.en: More... harder... I want to feel the man's yang energy inside the woman's yin... fill me up, fill me up completely.
